## TSS Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Financial Results


Mar 11, 2026


Full-Year 2025 Revenue of $246 million, up 66% Diluted EPS of $0.56 up 133% GEORGETOWN, TX / ACCESS Newswire / March 11, 2026 / TSS, Inc. (Nasdaq:TSSI), a data center services company that integrates AI and other high-performance computing infrastructure and software and provides related data center services, today reported results for its fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2025 . “We are pleased to have surpassed the upper end of our outlook for 2025,” said Darryll Dew…
